units.source_text: 弘徽殿太后也想前来问病，但因藤壶皇后常在一旁，有所嫌忌，踌躇不决。

en.t: The Kokiden Empress Dowager also wished to come and inquire after his illness, but because Empress Fujitsubo was often at his side, she felt uneasy and hesitated, unable to decide.

units.source_text: 正在此时，桐壶院病势虽不转剧，一旦忽然驾崩。

en.t: Just then, although the Kiritsubo Retired Emperor's condition had not worsened, he suddenly passed away one day.
When the terrible news spread, both the court and the country were shaken.

units.source_text: 诸王侯公卿暗自思忖：“桐壶院虽曰让位退居，其实依旧统治朝政，与在位时无异。

en.t: The princes, nobles, and high courtiers thought privately, "Although the Kiritsubo Retired Emperor was said to have abdicated and withdrawn, in truth he still governed affairs of state, no differently than when he was on the throne.

units.source_text: 今一旦晏驾，新帝年事尚幼，其外祖父右大臣性情急躁，刚愎用事。

en.t: Now that he has suddenly died, the new emperor is still young, and his maternal grandfather, the Minister of the Right, is hasty in temper and obstinately wields power.

units.source_text: 今后任其所为，世事将不堪设想。”

en.t: If he is allowed to do as he pleases from now on, the state of the world will become unbearable to imagine."

units.source_text: 至于藤壶皇后与源氏大将，当然更加悲恸，几乎不省人事。

en.t: As for Empress Fujitsubo and General Genji, they were naturally even more grief-stricken, almost losing consciousness from sorrow.

units.source_text: 七七四十九日的佛事供养，源氏大将比其他诸皇子特别虔诚郑重。

en.t: During the Buddhist memorial rites through the forty-ninth day, General Genji was especially devout and solemn, more so than the other imperial princes.

units.source_text: 世人认为此乃理之当然，大家深深同情他的悲哀。

en.t: People thought this only natural, and everyone deeply sympathized with his grief.

units.source_text: 他身穿葛布的丧服，形容憔悴，

en.t: He wore mourning robes of coarse kudzu cloth and looked worn and haggard,

units.source_text: 却反而富有朴素之美，使见者不胜怜悯。

en.t: yet this only gave him a simple beauty, stirring boundless pity in all who saw him.

units.source_text: 源氏大将去岁悼亡，今年丧父，连遭不幸，

en.t: General Genji had mourned a death the previous year and lost his father this year, suffering misfortune after misfortune,

units.source_text: 顿感人世可厌，颇思乘此机会，抛舍红尘，遁入空门。

en.t: and he suddenly felt the human world was hateful, strongly considering taking this chance to cast off worldly life and enter the Buddhist path.

units.source_text: 然而羁绊甚多，安能撒手？

en.t: Yet he had so many ties binding him; how could he simply let go?
